theorem lg_target {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.Abelian C] {I : C} [CategoryTheory.Injective I] {L : CochainComplex C ℤ} {i : ℤ} (ι : (CochainComplex.singleFunctor C i).obj I ⟶ L) [L.IsStrictlyGE i] [QuasiIsoAt ι i] : CategoryTheory.IsSplitMono ι := by
  have h : (CochainComplex.singleFunctor C i).obj I.IsStrictlyGE i := CochainComplex.instIsStrictlyGEObjIntSingleFunctor _ _
  have hq : QuasiIsoAt ι i := QuasiIsoAt.refl ι
  have hz : CategoryTheory.Limits.IsZero (L.X i) := by apply QuasiIsoAt.isZeroAt; exact hq
  have hz' : CategoryTheory.Limits.IsZero ((CochainComplex.singleFunctor C i).obj I).X i := by apply QuasiIsoAt.isZeroAt; exact hq
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := CategoryTheory.IsSplitMono.of_isZero (ι ≫ (CochainComplex.π i L)) hz
  refine { isSplitMono := s }
